summary.text: Elizabeth Bauer is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An actuary who has worked in pension consulting and health care, she says her priorities include public-sector pension funding and fiscal accountability.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Elizabeth Bauer said she is a 29-year resident of District 53 whose three children attended Rolling Meadows High School.

She said she is an actuary who has worked in pension consulting and more recently in the health care sector, holds undergraduate and graduate degrees in history, and recently earned a master's degree in applied economics from the University of Illinois at Chicago.
She said she has written about retirement issues as a senior contributor at Forbes and has contributed occasional op-eds to the Chicago Tribune.
Bauer advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.

In the survey, she listed fiscal responsibility, opposition to subsidies for individual businesses, and changes to the SAFE-T Act among her key messages, and named pensions and education spending among her priorities.
